rationale: The agent proceeded with an exchange without first authenticating the user, did not verify that the order belonged to the user on-record, and did not explicitly confirm the order-changing action before executing it. The final message states the exchange is already in motion and includes a $7.99 refund amount without visible tool-result support. Policy requires authentication, acting only on the user’s own orders, and explicit confirmation before any write. These steps are not evidenced here, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
